name: merges a transitive email and phone chain
input: three connected accounts plus one independent account

name: deduplicates contacts and retains accounts with no contacts
input: duplicates within and across accounts and one empty-contact account
test:
accounts = [
    {'name': 'Zoe', 'emails': ['z@example.com', 'z@example.com'], 'phones': ['9']},
    {'name': 'Zo', 'emails': ['z@example.com'], 'phones': ['9', '9']},
    {'name': 'No Contact', 'emails': [], 'phones': []},
]
assert merge_contact_accounts(accounts) == [
    {'names': ['No Contact'], 'emails': [], 'phones': []},
    {'names': ['Zo', 'Zoe'], 'emails': ['z@example.com'], 'phones': ['9']},
]
assert accounts[0]['emails'] == ['z@example.com', 'z@example.com']

name: does not merge email and phone namespaces or rely on input order
input: same text stored once as an email and once as a phone
